premises.text: Social media content consumption is too noisy and time-consuming; gems get lost in status updates, game invites, and volume
premises.evidence_span: The problem is it's just way too noisy

premises.text: Undrip is a noise-free mobile community focused only on sharing and discovering compelling web content (Path for links)
premises.evidence_span: It's all about sharing and discovering the most interesting and compelling content from around the web, noise-free

premises.text: Connect existing social accounts; algorithm surfaces best content using habits, friend relationships, and popularity with friend social context
premises.evidence_span: I can connect my Twitter, my Facebook, my Instagram, my Tumblr, and it'll analyze all the content that's coming through, and it'll surface the best stuff

premises.text: Implicit interests plus social context enable serendipity; drip reshare and follow tastemakers mix curators into the feed
premises.evidence_span: the big value of having social context a big part of the algorithm is that it introduces and allows for an element of surprise

premises.text: Product is mobile-first on iPhone/iPad (Android soon) leveraging existing social graph
premises.evidence_span: probably most importantly, it's all mobile

value.text: Discover and share the gems of the web with relevance and serendipity without noise
value.evidence_span: helps you discover and share the gems of the web

causal_links.evidence_span: What Google did for the web, which is create relevance and order to all the content out there, we're doing for the social web
We're on the iPhone. We're on the iPad. We're in the App Store

notes: Noise/volume/busy pains folded as one problem (§4.1.6). Community slice, feed connect, ranking signals, friend thumbnails, multi-media sections, drip, and tastemaker follow folded as discovery-product cascade (§4.1.7). Mobile-first as distribution premise. Bio/Chegg sale excluded. Three domains—anti-template.
